# Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE)

THIS CERTIFIES THAT in exchange for the payment of the Purchase Amount,
[Company] issues to the Investor the right to certain shares of capital
stock, subject to the terms set forth below.

## Article I. Events

### 1.1 Equity Financing

If there is an Equity Financing before the expiration or termination of
this SAFE, the SAFE will automatically convert into shares of standard
preferred stock at the Conversion Price.

### 1.2 Liquidity Event

If there is a Liquidity Event before the expiration of this SAFE, the
Investor will, at their option, either (i) receive a cash payment equal
to the Purchase Amount or (ii) automatically receive a number of shares
of common stock equal to the Purchase Amount divided by the Liquidity
Price.

## Article II. Definitions

"Conversion Price" means the lower of the price per share equal to the
Post-Money Valuation Cap divided by the Company Capitalization, or the
Safe Price.

"Equity Financing" means a bona fide transaction or series of related
transactions with the principal purpose of raising capital, pursuant to
which the Company issues and sells Preferred Stock at a fixed valuation.

## Article III. Company Representations

The Company represents and warrants that (a) it is duly organized and
validly existing under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation,
(b) the execution and performance of this SAFE will not result in any
breach of law or contract, and (c) it has obtained all necessary
authorizations to issue the SAFE.

## Article IV. Investor Representations

The Investor represents that they are an accredited investor and have
adequate financial means and sophistication to evaluate the risks of
this investment.

## Article V. Miscellaneous

Any provision of this SAFE may be amended only with the written consent
of the Company and the Investor. This SAFE is governed by the laws of
the State of Delaware.
